# 1. Load and validate the data

Keep this Rmd beside the GitData workbooks and knit to HTML, or pass their
directory as `params$data_dir` to `rmarkdown::render()`. The analysis uses
R packages readxl, dplyr, ez, ARTool, emmeans, knitr, and rmarkdown.

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ez)
library(ARTool)
library(emmeans)

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"), emmeans.lmer.df = "kenward-roger")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE)
alpha <- 0.05
interface_levels <- c("Basic", "FPVAR", "TPVAR", "BothAR")
interface_codes <- c(no = "Basic", basic = "Basic", fpv = "FPVAR",
                     fpvar = "FPVAR", tpv = "TPVAR", tpvar = "TPVAR",
                     both = "BothAR", bothar = "BothAR")

read_input <- function(file, sheet = 1) {
  read_excel(file.path(params$data_dir, file), sheet = sheet,
             .name_repair = "unique_quiet")
}

prepare <- function(data, levels_by_factor, measures, participants) {
  fields <- c("participant", names(levels_by_factor), measures)
  stopifnot(all(fields %in% names(data)))
  data <- as.data.frame(data[fields])
  data$participant <- factor(data$participant)
  for (field in names(levels_by_factor)) {
    values <- trimws(as.character(data[[field]]))
    if (field == "interface" && identical(levels_by_factor[[field]], interface_levels)) {
      values <- unname(interface_codes[tolower(values)])
    }
    data[[field]] <- factor(values, levels_by_factor[[field]])
  }
  stopifnot(!anyNA(data), nlevels(data$participant) == participants,
            all(do.call(table, data[c("participant", names(levels_by_factor))]) == 1L))
  for (measure in measures) {
    stopifnot(is.numeric(data[[measure]]), all(is.finite(data[[measure]])))
  }
  data
}

four_interfaces <- list(interface = interface_levels)
cue_levels <- list(interface = c("LS", "CC", "CP"))
system_levels <- c(list(tool = c("real", "sim")), four_interfaces)
view_levels <- c(system_levels, list(view = c("fpv", "tpv")))

load_task <- function(task_sheet, questionnaire_sheet, count) {
  list(
    performance = prepare(read_input("1,3_task performance.xlsx", task_sheet),
                          four_interfaces, c("time", count), 20),
    nasa = prepare(read_input("1,3_NasaTLX.xlsx", questionnaire_sheet),
                   four_interfaces, "score", 20),
    sus = prepare(read_input("1,3_SUS.xlsx", questionnaire_sheet),
                  four_interfaces, "score", 20)
  )
}

avoidance <- load_task("ObstacleAvoidance", "collision", "collision")
search <- load_task("TargetSearch", "target", "target")
stopifnot(identical(levels(avoidance$performance$participant),
                    levels(search$performance$participant)))
cue_raw <- read_input("2_cueDesign.xlsx")
cue_measures <- c("time", "avg30cm", "SUS", intersect("total30cm", names(cue_raw)))
cue <- prepare(cue_raw, cue_levels, cue_measures, 6)

# Identify the two second-evaluation workbooks by worksheet name.
system_files <- c("2_performance.xlsx", "2_eyetracking.xlsx")
read_system <- function(sheet) {
  matches <- vapply(system_files, function(file) {
    sheet %in% excel_sheets(file.path(params$data_dir, file))
  }, logical(1))
  stopifnot(sum(matches) == 1L)
  read_input(system_files[matches], sheet)
}
real_sim <- prepare(read_system("phase2_new"), system_levels,
                    c("completion", "collision", "stay30cm", "nasa", "sus", "TPVratio"), 16)
eye_real_sim <- prepare(read_system("task performance"), view_levels,
                        c("duration", "avg_duration"), 16)
stopifnot(identical(levels(real_sim$participant), levels(eye_real_sim$participant)),
          all(real_sim$TPVratio >= 0 & real_sim$TPVratio <= 1))
real_sim$TPVratio <- 100 * real_sim$TPVratio

'# Eye-tracking data for Figures 15 and 22.'
stage1_eye_path <- file.path(params$data_dir, "1,3_eyetracking.xlsx")
```

```{r helpers, include=FALSE}
show <- function(data) {
  if (!nrow(data)) {
    cat("No follow-up comparisons selected.\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  for (name in grep("(^p$|^p_|_p$)", names(data), value = TRUE)) {
    data[[name]] <- format.pval(data[[name]], digits = 4, eps = 1e-16)
  }
  print(knitr::kable(data, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE))
  cat("\n\n")
}

describe <- function(data, factors) {
  data |>
    group_by(across(all_of(factors))) |>
    summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(y), SD = sd(y), median = median(y),
              IQR = IQR(y), .groups = "drop")
}

normality <- function(values) {
  if (length(values) < 3L || diff(range(values)) < sqrt(.Machine$double.eps)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  shapiro.test(values)$p.value
}

rm_fit <- function(data, factors) {
  within <- as.call(c(quote(.), lapply(factors, as.name)))
  fit <- eval(substitute(ez::ezANOVA(data = data, dv = y, wid = participant,
                                   within = W, type = 3, detailed = TRUE),
                         list(W = within)))
  tests <- subset(fit$ANOVA, Effect != "(Intercept)")
  mauchly <- fit[["Mauchly's Test for Sphericity"]]
  correction <- fit[["Sphericity Corrections"]]
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(tests)), function(i) {
    row <- tests[i, ]
    p_mauchly <- if (is.null(mauchly)) NA_real_ else
      mauchly$p[match(row$Effect, mauchly$Effect)]
    use_gg <- !is.na(p_mauchly) && p_mauchly < alpha
    gg <- correction[match(row$Effect, correction$Effect), ]
    eps <- if (use_gg) min(1, gg$GGe) else 1
    data.frame(Effect = row$Effect, df1 = row$DFn * eps, df2 = row$DFd * eps,
               F = row$F, p = if (use_gg) gg[["p[GG]"]] else row$p,
               eta_p2 = row$SSn / (row$SSn + row$SSd),
               Mauchly_p = p_mauchly, GG = use_gg)
  }))
}

paired <- function(delta, method) {
  if (method == "t") {
    if (sd(delta) == 0) return(data.frame(t = NA, df = length(delta)-1,
                                          p = NA, difference = mean(delta),
                                          CI_low = NA, CI_high = NA, d_z = NA))
    fit <- t.test(delta)
    return(data.frame(t = unname(fit$statistic), df = unname(fit$parameter),
                      p = fit$p.value, difference = mean(delta),
                      CI_low = fit$conf.int[1], CI_high = fit$conf.int[2],
                      d_z = mean(delta) / sd(delta)))
  }
  nonzero <- delta[delta != 0]
  if (!length(nonzero)) return(data.frame(V = 0, p = 1, r_rb = NA))
  fit <- wilcox.test(delta, exact = FALSE, correct = TRUE)
  ranks <- rank(abs(nonzero))
  data.frame(V = unname(fit$statistic), p = fit$p.value,
             r_rb = 2 * sum(ranks[nonzero > 0]) / sum(ranks) - 1)
}

pair_table <- function(data, focal, method) {
  pairs <- combn(levels(data[[focal]]), 2, simplify = FALSE)
  bind_rows(lapply(pairs, function(groups) {
    a <- data[data[[focal]] == groups[1], ]
    b <- data[data[[focal]] == groups[2], ]
    b <- b[match(a$participant, b$participant), ]
    stopifnot(identical(a$participant, b$participant))
    cbind(contrast = paste(groups, collapse = " - "), paired(a$y - b$y, method))
  }))
}

adjust_pairs <- function(data) {
  if (nrow(data)) data$p_Bonferroni <- p.adjust(data$p, "bonferroni", n = nrow(data))
  data
}

one_way <- function(data, measure, label, method) {
  data$y <- data[[measure]]
  cat("### ", label, "\n\n", sep = "")
  show(describe(data, "interface"))
  show(data.frame(Shapiro_p = normality(residuals(lm(y ~ participant + interface, data)))))
  if (method == "Friedman") {
    test <- friedman.test(y ~ interface | participant, data)
    chi <- unname(test$statistic)
    omnibus <- data.frame(test = method, chi_squared = chi, df = unname(test$parameter),
                          p = test$p.value, Kendall_W = chi /
                            (nlevels(data$participant) * (nlevels(data$interface) - 1)))
  } else {
    omnibus <- rm_fit(data, "interface")
  }
  show(omnibus)
  if (omnibus$p < alpha) {
    show(adjust_pairs(pair_table(data, "interface", if (method == "Friedman") "Wilcoxon" else "t")))
  }
}

stage1_eye <- function(sheet, dominant) {
  if (!file.exists(stage1_eye_path)) {
    cat("Eye-tracking results require the corresponding worksheet of 1,3_eyetracking.xlsx.\n\n")
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }
  raw <- read_input("1,3_eyetracking.xlsx", sheet)
  names(raw)[match(c("task", "AOI"), names(raw))] <- c("interface", "view")
  eye <- prepare(raw, c(four_interfaces, list(view = c("fpv", "tpv"))),
                 c("percent", "mean"), 20)
  data <- reshape(eye, idvar = c("participant", "interface"),
                  timevar = "view", direction = "wide")
  performance <- if (sheet == "collision") avoidance$performance else search$performance
  keys <- function(x) paste(x$participant, x$interface)
  stopifnot(setequal(keys(data), keys(performance)),
            all(abs(data$percent.fpv + data$percent.tpv - 1) < 1e-6))
  data$FPV_percent <- 100 * data$percent.fpv
  data$TPV_percent <- 100 * data$percent.tpv
  data$meanFPV <- data$mean.fpv
  data$meanTPV <- data$mean.tpv
  for (metric in c("Fixation proportion (%)", "Mean fixation duration (ms)")) {
    columns <- if (metric == "Fixation proportion (%)") {
      c("FPV_percent", "TPV_percent")
    } else c("meanFPV", "meanTPV")
    cat("### ", metric, "\n\n", sep = "")
    comparisons <- bind_rows(lapply(split(data, data$interface), function(rows) {
      delta <- rows[[columns[1]]] - rows[[columns[2]]]
      cbind(interface = rows$interface[1],
            FPV_mean = mean(rows[[columns[1]]]), FPV_SD = sd(rows[[columns[1]]]),
            TPV_mean = mean(rows[[columns[2]]]), TPV_SD = sd(rows[[columns[2]]]),
            Shapiro_p = normality(delta),
            paired(delta, if (metric == "Fixation proportion (%)") "t" else "Wilcoxon"))
    }))
    show(adjust_pairs(comparisons))
  }
  one_way(data, paste0(dominant, "_percent"),
          paste(dominant, "fixation proportion across interfaces"), "Friedman")
}

followup_scopes <- function(omnibus, factors) {
  significant <- omnibus$Effect[omnibus$p < alpha]
  interactions <- strsplit(significant[grepl(":", significant)], ":", fixed = TRUE)
  scopes <- setNames(rep(NA_character_, length(factors)), factors)
  for (focal in factors) {
    if (any(vapply(interactions, function(x) focal %in% x, logical(1)))) {
      scopes[focal] <- "conditional"
    } else if (focal %in% significant) {
      scopes[focal] <- "marginal"
    }
  }
  scopes[!is.na(scopes)]
}

art_followups <- function(model, factors, scopes) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(scopes), function(focal) {
    scope <- scopes[[focal]]
    term <- if (scope == "marginal") focal else paste(factors, collapse = ":")
    contrasts <- as.data.frame(summary(art.con(model, term, adjust = "none")))
    if (scope == "conditional") {
      pairs <- strsplit(as.character(contrasts$contrast), " - ", fixed = TRUE)
      keep <- vapply(pairs, function(pair) {
        a <- strsplit(pair[1], ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
        b <- strsplit(pair[2], ",", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
        stopifnot(length(a) == length(factors), length(b) == length(factors))
        identical(factors[a != b], focal)
      }, logical(1))
      contrasts <- contrasts[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    }
    data.frame(Factor = focal, Scope = scope, Contrast = contrasts$contrast,
               t = contrasts$t.ratio, df = contrasts$df, p = contrasts$p.value,
               d_rank = contrasts$estimate / sigma(artlm.con(model, term))) |>
      adjust_pairs()
  }))
}

factorial <- function(data, measure, label, factors, method) {
  data$y <- data[[measure]]
  rhs <- paste(factors, collapse = "*")
  cat("### ", label, "\n\n", sep = "")
  show(describe(data, factors))
  diagnostics <- lm(reformulate(c("participant", rhs), "y"), data)
  show(data.frame(Method = method, Shapiro_p = normality(residuals(diagnostics))))
  if (method == "ART") {
    model <- art(as.formula(paste("y ~", rhs, "+ (1 | participant)")), data)
    tests <- as.data.frame(anova(model))
    omnibus <- data.frame(Effect = rownames(tests), df1 = tests$Df,
                          df2 = tests$Df.res, F = tests$F, p = tests[["Pr(>F)"]])
    omnibus$eta_p2_approx <- with(omnibus, F * df1 / (F * df1 + df2))
    show(omnibus)
    scopes <- followup_scopes(omnibus, factors)
    comparisons <- art_followups(model, factors, scopes)
    # The manuscript additionally reports the overall collision environment contrast.
    if (measure == "collision") {
      comparisons <- bind_rows(comparisons, art_followups(model, factors, c(tool = "marginal")))
    }
    show(comparisons)
  } else {
    omnibus <- rm_fit(data, factors)
    show(omnibus)
    scopes <- followup_scopes(omnibus, factors)
    stopifnot(all(scopes == "marginal"))
    comparisons <- bind_rows(lapply(names(scopes), function(focal) {
      marginal <- aggregate(data["y"], data[c("participant", focal)], mean)
      cbind(Factor = focal, adjust_pairs(pair_table(marginal, focal, "t")))
    }))
    show(comparisons)
  }
}
```

# 2. Initial interface evaluation: obstacle avoidance

Use four paired interface conditions. Run the Table 5 omnibus tests, followed by
Bonferroni-adjusted contrasts where selected. For eye tracking, compare FPV and
TPV within each interface and test TPV proportions across interfaces.

```{r initial, results='asis'}
one_way(avoidance$performance, "time", "Completion time (s)", "Friedman")
one_way(avoidance$performance, "collision", "Collision count", "Friedman")
one_way(avoidance$nasa, "score", "Weighted NASA-TLX", "RM ANOVA")
one_way(avoidance$sus, "score", "SUS", "RM ANOVA")
stage1_eye("collision", "TPV")
```

# 3. Exploratory TPV AR cue evaluation

Compare LS, CC, and CP within six participants. Summarize total dwell time
when that column is supplied.

```{r cues, results='asis'}
one_way(cue, "time", "Completion time (s)", "Friedman")
one_way(cue, "avg30cm", "Mean warning-zone dwell time (s)", "RM ANOVA")
one_way(cue, "SUS", "SUS", "RM ANOVA")

if ("total30cm" %in% names(cue)) {
  cat("### Total warning-zone dwell time (s)\n\n")
  show(describe(transform(cue, y = total30cm), "interface"))
} else {
  cat("Table 6 total dwell time is unavailable in the supplied cue workbook.\n\n")
}

detectable_dz <- uniroot(function(dz) {
  power.t.test(n = 6, delta = dz, sd = 1, sig.level = alpha / 3,
               type = "paired", alternative = "two.sided", strict = TRUE)$power - 0.80
}, c(0.1, 5))$root
show(data.frame(n = 6, comparisons = 3, per_comparison_alpha = alpha / 3,
                power = 0.80, detectable_d_z = detectable_dz))
```

# 4. Second interface evaluation: real and simulated obstacle avoidance

Use the Table 5 models. Include environment and interface for trial outcomes,
and add view for the two fixation-duration outcomes. Report Shapiro–Wilk
diagnostics. Adjust post-hoc p-values by Bonferroni within each outcome,
factor, and scope. Report conditional comparisons for factors involved in
significant interactions and marginal comparisons for other significant effects.
Keep the recorded 0 s values for trials without a warning-zone entry.

```{r second, results='asis'}
two_factors <- names(system_levels)
three_factors <- names(view_levels)
factorial(real_sim, "completion", "Completion time (s)", two_factors, "ART")
factorial(real_sim, "collision", "Collision count", two_factors, "ART")
factorial(real_sim, "stay30cm", "Mean warning-zone dwell time (s)", two_factors, "ART")
factorial(eye_real_sim, "duration", "Total fixation duration (ms)", three_factors, "ART")
factorial(real_sim, "TPVratio", "TPV fixation proportion (%)", two_factors, "ART")
factorial(eye_real_sim, "avg_duration", "Mean fixation duration (ms)", three_factors, "ART")
factorial(real_sim, "nasa", "Weighted NASA-TLX", two_factors, "RM ANOVA")
factorial(real_sim, "sus", "SUS", two_factors, "ART")
```

## Relative interface effects

For each participant and environment, subtract Basic from each AR condition.
Report the mean difference and pointwise 95% t interval as in Figure 20.

```{r relative}
relative <- function(measure, label) {
  data <- transform(real_sim, y = real_sim[[measure]])
  bind_rows(lapply(split(data, data$tool), function(rows) {
    basic <- rows[rows$interface == "Basic", ]
    bind_rows(lapply(interface_levels[-1], function(level) {
      ar <- rows[rows$interface == level, ]
      delta <- ar$y - basic$y[match(ar$participant, basic$participant)]
      margin <- qt(0.975, length(delta) - 1) * sd(delta) / sqrt(length(delta))
      data.frame(Outcome = label, Environment = rows$tool[1],
                 Contrast = paste(level, "- Basic"), n = length(delta),
                 Difference = mean(delta), CI_low = mean(delta) - margin,
                 CI_high = mean(delta) + margin)
    }))
  }))
}
show(bind_rows(relative("completion", "Completion time (s)"),
               relative("TPVratio", "TPV fixation proportion (percentage points)"),
               relative("nasa", "Weighted NASA-TLX"),
               relative("sus", "SUS")))
```

# 5. Matrix-guided interface evaluation: target search

Use four paired interface conditions. Apply the Table 5 tests and Bonferroni
adjustment. For eye tracking, test FPV versus TPV within each interface and
test FPV proportions across interfaces.

```{r search, results='asis'}
one_way(search$performance, "time", "Completion time (s)", "Friedman")
one_way(search$performance, "target", "Target revisit count", "Friedman")
one_way(search$nasa, "score", "Weighted NASA-TLX", "RM ANOVA")
one_way(search$sus, "score", "SUS", "RM ANOVA")
stage1_eye("target", "FPV")
```

# 6. Input coverage and software versions

`1,3_NasaTLX.xlsx` supplies the weighted scores used for inference.
`1,3_eyetracking.xlsx` supplies both first-stage eye-tracking worksheets.
The cue workbook needs `total30cm` for the descriptive total dwell column in Table 6.

```{r versions}
show(data.frame(
  Software = c("R", "readxl", "dplyr", "ez", "ARTool", "emmeans", "knitr", "rmarkdown"),
  Version = c(as.character(getRversion()),
              vapply(c("readxl", "dplyr", "ez", "ARTool", "emmeans", "knitr", "rmarkdown"),
                     function(package) as.character(packageVersion(package)), character(1)))
))
```
